name: Default Linux Universal
postCreateCommand: TERRAFORM_VERSION=$(curl -s https://checkpoint-api.hashicorp.com/v1/check/terraform | jq -r .current_version) && curl -fsSL https://releases.hashicorp.com/terraform/${TERRAFORM_VERSION}/terraform_${TERRAFORM_VERSION}_linux_amd64.zip -o /tmp/terraform.zip && sudo unzip -o /tmp/terraform.zip -d /usr/local/bin/ && rm /tmp/terraform.zip
